text: In Tokyo, plant shop worker Michi Kudo finds her colleague Taguchi [hanged in his apartment|images|ropes, cages and executions], leaving behind a disk of looping images and a black stain on the wall. Across the city, economics student Ryosuke Kawashima watches his computer open a website by itself, showing [people alone in dark rooms|who_suffers|the lonely and isolated]. Doors sealed with red tape mark [forbidden rooms|trigger|breaking a rule] where ghosts wait, and as friends fade into stains on the wall, [people begin to vanish en masse|who_suffers|whole communities].
